A.text: Hi [Name], I'm [your role] at [company]. We're working on [problem area] and I'd love to hear your take — is [specific pain point] something you deal with? Would be great to chat briefly. Cheers, [Your Name]

B.text: Hi [Name], I noticed [something specific about them/their company]. I'm exploring [your area] and curious whether [specific question]. Happy to share what I've learned so far. Up for a quick chat? [Your Name]

NONE.rationale: A/B test: does a noteless invite get more accepts than a templated one? Some research suggests bare invites accept higher because they look less salesy. daily-targets.js routes every 3rd new-DM here automatically. Delete this entry to disable the experiment.

FU.text: Hi [Name], thanks for accepting! As previously stated, I'm exploring [your area] and curious about [specific question]. Would love your perspective — up for a quick 15min chat? [Your Name]
FU.rationale: Default follow-up. References the connection note ('as previously stated'). Works for leads connected via A/B/C — does NOT work for NONE (no connection note to reference).

FU-B.text: Hi [Name], thanks for accepting! I'm exploring [your area] and I'd love your take — is [specific pain point] something you deal with? Happy to share what I've learned. Up for a quick chat? [Your Name]
FU-B.rationale: Follow-up variant for NONE-connected leads. Pitches the problem fresh (no 'previously stated' anchor since there was no connection note).

FU-C.text: Hi [Name], thanks for accepting! Quick ask — I'm validating [your problem area] and looking for feedback from people who do this work. Up for a 15min chat? [Your Name]
FU-C.rationale: Follow-up variant for NONE-connected leads. Direct call-ask opener.

FU-FREE.text: (freelance — bespoke message tailored to the lead, not from a template)
FU-FREE.rationale: Marker for hand-written follow-ups. Use when none of FU/FU-B/FU-C fits and you composed something custom. Lets you measure 'tailored vs templated' over time.
